title: FOMC minutes — the October 26-27, 2027 meeting (14:00 ET, three weeks after the decision)
source: EST: the Board's own publication rule applied to a decision date this session re-fetched, with the ONE displacement mechanism that can break it measured across the full 21-year record rather than assumed. THE RULE is verbatim from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, page stamp 'Last Update: August 19, 2026'): 'The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision.' THE MEETING is the same page's 2027 panel, 'October 26-27', with no Summary of Economic Projections asterisk; 2027-10-26 is a Tuesday and 2027-10-27 a Wednesday (computed, not assumed), so the decision is Wednesday 2027-10-27 and D+21 is Wednesday 2027-11-17. THE ARITHMETIC IS NOT INHERITED. This session re-parsed the live page plus fomchistorical2007.htm through fomchistorical2020.htm (fifteen pages, HTTP 200 each), pairing each meeting's minutes link -- both the pre-2008 /fomc/minutes/YYYYMMDD form and the later fomcminutesYYYYMMDD form -- to that meeting's own '(Released <Month> <D>, <YYYY>)' string, and cutting each year panel at its footnote block first (the 2027 panel's footnote names a January 25-26, 2028 meeting, which a year-scoped parse otherwise returns as a phantom ninth 2027 meeting). It returns 157 releases, decisions 2007-01-31 through 2026-07-29, of which 143 sit at exactly D+21 -- reproducing the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 lane's census exactly, from an independent construction. THE RISK THIS ENTRY EXISTS TO PRICE, AND IT IS BIGGER THAN THE SEEDING PROPOSALS KNEW: 6 of those 14 exceptions are November releases of the autumn meeting, this entry's own class. Pooled one-per-year 2007-2025 (decision days 10-24 through 11-08, an unbroken 16-day cluster), the autumn slot runs 7 displaced of 19 -- 36.8%, the worst class in the record, against September's 19 of 19 perfect. THE 2027 DATE SURVIVES ON A MEASURED MECHANISM, NOT ON THAT BASE RATE. Every one of the 7 displacements had D+21 landing ON Thanksgiving or on the Wednesday immediately before it; all 8 instances whose D+21 sat further away held at exactly D+21, 8 for 8. The distance is quantised -- D+21 preserves the decision day's weekday and Thanksgiving is always a Thursday, so the observed gaps are only -8, -1, 0 and +7, with no intermediate case in 19 years. 2027-11-17 sits at gap -8: Thanksgiving 2027 is Thursday November 25 per nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct this session (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes) and per the OCC's own 2027 calendar, which marks 2027-11-25 an 'Exchange/OCC holiday'. Adjacency is necessary but NOT sufficient and the entry says so: inside the gap<=1 bucket the practice is era-dependent (4 of 4 displaced 2007-2011, 1 of 5 2016-2022, 2 of 2 2023-2024). The 14:00 ET publication time is the Board's standing convention and is not stated on this page. Filed estimate because a firm rule on a date the Board itself calls tentative cannot outrank its input -- the same page states 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it' -- so the promotion trigger is the 2027-09-14/15 meeting ratifying October 26-27, not a better fetch. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial-research lane (2026-09-08) after reading ALL THREE prior proposals -- from-fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26, from-fomc-2027-10-26 and from-fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 -- which are now inert and stay where they are. Every claim they made was re-derived from the primaries rather than inherited. TWO OF THE THREE HELD; ONE IS CORRECTED. The from-fomc-2027-10-26 proposal reassured on a census of '42 of 45 at exactly D+21' with three exceptions, and named the right hazard class -- 'two of the three exceptions are the November minutes of a November autumn meeting'. That census was the live page alone (2021-2026). The full 21-year census is 143 of 157 with FOURTEEN exceptions, of which SIX are this class, and the class rate is 7 of 19 rather than 2 of 3. The proposal's CONCLUSION -- that these dates are clear -- survives, and is now carried by a mechanism with a measured margin (8 days) instead of by a thin count. THE GENERALISABLE RESULT, and it is a method result: a computable mechanism retires a base rate. Three different displacement rates describe one class depending on the bin -- October-meeting minutes 1 of 8 (12.5%), November-meeting minutes 6 of 11 (54.5%), pooled autumn slot 7 of 19 (36.8%) -- and all three are irrelevant to 2027, because the Thanksgiving gap is computable and puts this release in the bucket that is 0 for 8. This is the same bin-split artifact the fomc-2027-10-26 lane found on the decision-day side, recurring on the release side; a later lane quoting any of the three numbers for 2027 would be quoting a number that cannot apply. WHAT THE RESEARCH ADDS ON THE TAPE, and both findings are refusals. (1) The autumn slot is the ANTI-SEPTEMBER. Where the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 lane found September's releases at the twelve-month maximum (S&P up 16 of 19, VIX down 17 of 19) and retired it as a scan artifact, the neighbouring slot in the same years runs S&P up 7 of 19 and VIX down 11 of 19, mean |S&P| 0.782% against a 0.798% universe (permutation P = 0.472). An independent subgroup pointing the other way is exactly the out-of-sample evidence that sibling's FT-2 asked for, arriving early. (2) The family's headline VIX number is explained away, not extended. VIX falls on 64.3% of the 157 releases -- but split by whether the release shares its session with the monthly VIX settlement (both are Wednesdays, so 50 of 157 collide) it is 71.0% on the 107 that do not and exactly 50.0% on the 50 that do, a 21.0pp gap at two-sided permutation p = 0.0122. The expiration half sits on the 54.4% universe base rate: no effect at all. 2027-11-17 IS an expiration-coincident release -- the OCC's own 2027 calendar marks it 'Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date' -- so whatever residue of the family's vol story anyone still carries does not reach this release by construction. Stated honestly: the split was handed to this lane by the OCC file while sourcing an adjacency rather than pre-registered, and residualised on the same session's index move it shrinks to -0.09 against -0.19, so it is a mechanism for part of a raw number, not a new edge. THREE ADJACENCIES PROPOSED IN THE SAME PR, all dated, all untracked, all load-bearing here: vix-expiration-2027-11-17 (D+0, the confound above), opex-2027-11-19 (D+2, the positioning date the 2026 twin ledger named in its own signals list) and thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25 (D+8, the mechanism this entry's whole date rests on). SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS EVERY MACRO ENTRY: symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates- or minutes-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
